main_text.p: modū Francia pro insula Francia qvan-doqve ufurpatur ; exempla habes apud Concilia & Patres obvia, qvi passim scri-bebant: Episcopi, qvi sunt in Ægypto, Thebaide, Libya, Pentapoli, &c. ex qvo liqvidò patet, Ægyptum non esse accipi-endam pro tota Patriarchatûs Dioecesi, sed pro peculiari illius Patriarchatûs Provincia. Eutychius itaqve hoc negat duntaxat, sc. nullum Patriarcham ab Ha-nania usqʒ ad Demetrium in Alexandria & ejus Provincia constituisse, qvam pe-culiarem assertionem universalem inter-pretatur malitiosè Seldenus, & alterum committit mendum substituens perso-nam, seu dignitatem personæ pro loco. Electio autem, impositio manuum, bene-dictio & constitutio Patriarchæ, qvæ ab illis duodecim Presbyteris Alexandrinis fiebant, nullum prorsus facessunt ei negotiū, qvi vetusta illius Ecclesiæ evolvit mo-numenta & mores ac ritus probè intelli-git. Electio enim denotat apud Alexandri-nos privatam, & qvæ intra parietes ab il-lis solis duodecim, & ex solo duodenario illo

page.notes: Line-end "duodenario" is printed as "duodenari" followed by a damaged "o" at the margin; read as duodenario, not certain [?]. The final word "illo" continues onto the next page and is set right-aligned as printed. Scan edges and show-through ignored. Some letters in the scan are faint (e.g. "Aegyptum" spelling, "Electio" italics) but read as printed.
